summary: M27 P1 Security Hardening — Fix 3 HIGH security issues (SEC-001 text length DoS, SEC-002 path traversal, SEC-004 NaN/Infinity weight injection) by creating a shared input-validation module and rolling it out across all MCP endpoints and services.
approach: Create a centralized input-validation.ts module exporting three reusable validators (validateStringLength, safeResolveWorkspaceRoot, validateWeight). Wave 1 creates the module. Wave 2 applies all three HIGH fixes in parallel (reader endpoints length guards, workspace path traversal guards, weight NaN/Infinity guards). Wave 3 rolls out shared validation to remaining chat.ts. Waves 4-5 add unit and integration tests. Wave 6 verifies no regressions. Collision risk on reader-endpoints.ts is managed via TASK-004 depending on TASK-002.

stages: Endpoints import and call validators on incoming request data
Validators return HttpResponse | null (error response or pass-through null)
Invalid input returns 413/400 immediately; valid input flows to business logic

design_decisions: Centralized module over per-endpoint ad-hoc validation — single source of truth, easier audit
Validators return HttpResponse | null matching chat.ts pattern — early-return guard, no exception throwing
safeResolveWorkspaceRoot returns string (resolved root) or throws — callers use try/catch for 400 response
validateWeight uses Number.isFinite() before range check per parseInt NaN semantic trap spec
chat.ts validateChatMessagesLimits refactored to delegate to shared module internally but keep same public signature — backward compatible
Reader endpoints use 413 Payload Too Large for length overflow (per HTTP spec), 400 for other validation errors

patterns: Guard-return pattern: validator returns HttpResponse on error, null on pass
jsonResponse({ error: '...' }, statusCode) for error responses
resolveWorkspaceRoot() local function pattern repeated across 11 files — consolidate to safeResolveWorkspaceRoot()
conventions: Error responses use jsonResponse helper from http-types.ts

pressure_pass.concern: Replacing NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE across 11 source files is a wide-spanning change; existing tests set this env var directly and may break if safeResolveWorkspaceRoot adds containment checks that reject previously-accepted paths
pressure_pass.mitigation: safeResolveWorkspaceRoot accepts process.cwd() as default allowed root; existing tests that set NIKO_WORKFLOW_WORKSPACE to absolute paths within or equal to cwd will pass. Tests using paths like 'C:/tmp/workspace-root' may fail containment if cwd is different — those tests will need updating in TASK-007 to set a contained test fixture directory

collision_notes: reader-endpoints.ts is edited by TASK-002 (length guards on 7 endpoints) and TASK-004 (weight validation on rsCreateCustomPersonaEndpoint + adjustPersonaWeights NaN safety). TASK-004 depends on TASK-002 to serialize edits. TASK-007 (integration tests for reader) depends on TASK-004 completing first. chat.ts optional refactor (TASK-005) depends on TASK-001 for the shared module import.
